summary.answer: InheritFrom is executed at the cited class assignments, not merely imported. Missing/falsy base throws explicit LUI Error. Otherwise makes a new table with super=base, sets its metatable __index=base, creates a fresh m_eventHandlers table with __index=base.m_eventHandlers, then returns the new class. It shares fallback handlers while permitting per-class handler writes. Does not instantiate widgets, invoke inherited callbacks or close anything. Metatable/native VM behavior and base fields are assumed, no further validation.

summary.answer: Builds the director map/image/titles, host and nonhost playlist headers, party-leader prompt, event timer, XP icons and official badge. Header Hidden predicates are complementary current-menu host tests; session/model callbacks revalidate them. Official badge requires IsCustomMPLobby AND default custom options; timer NextEvent is replaced by AlwaysFalse. Parent Unselectable and Disabled are also locally AlwaysFalse. Frozen same-class reset/focus/disabled/unselectable clips and close body define presentation/disposal only. Caller mode/state determines HMH membership; the MP-custom official branch is excluded for a distinct WZ menu.
